confidence_notes: FX is the RBA observation for 2026-11-18 (0.6720 USD per AUD), taken from a search result snippet. Food and drink anchors come from one search of crowdsourced cost-of-living sites (Traveltables, dated 2023, and MyLifeElsewhere). These sites disagree and use outdated currency labels, so the figures are rough. I ran no searches for cocktails or wine. Those two are estimated from the beer price: a cocktail at about 2.5 times the beer, and wine at about 2 times. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates, not checked against any listings. Cuban casa particulares and the informal market make prices volatile, and the official and informal exchange rates diverge.
comparable_city_reasoning: Paladar and tourist-area pricing in Havana, benchmarked against crowdsourced Havana indexes and loosely against other low-cost Caribbean and Latin American tourist cities.
